name: DBX SQL Guard
description: SQL risk review and approval trail for DBX.
releaseNotes: Screen-copy release: the engine, the SQLite store, the hash chain, the CSV export, the rule set and the declared permissions are unchanged, so installing it does not re-ask for consent. The audit database's path moved off the review header — the screen people screenshot — to under the audit list, folded to ~, with the absolute path one hover or one *Copy full path* away; guard/ping gained a display form and no MCP tool result may carry the file location. The host card is renamed to *Connection metadata & estimated rows* and lost its developer-only paragraph, and the AI progress line now says only *Generating…*. Requires DBX >= 0.6.38. Advisory only: DBX has no pre-execution hook, so nothing here blocks a statement from running. Verified with 106 Rust tests and five jsdom harnesses driving the real sidecar, run again against the packaged binary.
